task.question: Does TC-041 exercise every behavior in FE-03?

evidence.content: FE-03 forwards a notification and propagates remote dismissal back to the source device.
TC-041: send a notification; expect it to appear on the peer device.

candidate_output.summary: The test covers forwarding but not remote dismissal.
candidate_output.reasoning_summary: The requirement defines two behaviors, while the test procedure and expectation exercise only appearance on the peer.
candidate_output.recommended_action: Add a traced dismissal action and expected source-device outcome.
